name: maqueta-jujuy
description: Maqueta 3D del relieve de Jujuy (WebGPU + vgpu)

scripts.check:wgsl: node -e "const{readdirSync}=require('node:fs'),{join}=require('node:path'),{execFileSync}=require('node:child_process');const files=[];const walk=(d)=>{for(const e of readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())walk(p);else if(e.name.endsWith('.wgsl'))files.push(p)}};walk('src');if(files.length===0)console.log('check:wgsl: no .wgsl files under src/');for(const f of files){console.log('vgpu check '+f);execFileSync(process.execPath,['node_modules/vgpu/bin/vgpu.js','check',f],{stdio:'inherit'})}"
